snippet.title: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE | RELEASE DATE TRAILER
snippet.description:
BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is a psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication, and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

OUT SEPTEMBER 10th, 2026

👉 PLAY the demo now on Steam and add it to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886200/BrokenLore_DONT_LIE/

🕹️ The game will also be available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S:
https://publish.playstation.net/concepts/10016255

🎮 Discover more BROKENLORE titles on Steam and PlayStation
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/search/brokenlore
